border.$description: The edge of a level-1 layer, the same as every level's: envUI draws no shadows, so the edge and the fill set a floating layer apart.

The edge of menus, Select and Combobox lists, popovers, hover cards, pickers, rich text suggestions, docked panels and drag images: about 2:1 against a popup's own fill and the page, and at least 1.6:1 against every surface it floats over.

The edge of dialogs, sheets and the command palette where they are solid, the same as level 2's; a modal's backdrop sets it apart as well. A dialog and the palette otherwise part by their fill and the popups' soft shadow, a sheet by its fill.

elevation.$description: Elevation 0–3: the edge color of each level, for layers that float over the page. A floating layer shows this edge where it is solid, at high contrast, with reduced transparency and under forced colors; elsewhere popups and dialogs part by their fill and a soft shadow, and a modal by its backdrop as well. Level 0 is flat; menus, Select lists and popovers take level 2, dialogs and sheets level 3. Levels 1–3 share one edge, clearly visible at about 2:1 against a popup and the page; in high contrast it is the 4.5:1 boundary, and under forced colors the system's.
